svg.title: WaveLSFormer: learnable wavelet Transformer for long-short trading
svg.desc: Noisy hourly returns pass through a learnable low-pass and high-pass filter bank kept apart by spectral regularizers; low-guided high-frequency injection computes attention from the low band and injects gated high-band values; a Transformer outputs a long or short position trained directly on a risk-aware return objective.

g.text: Noisy hourly returns of related assets
Learnable wavelet filters split low / high frequency
LGHI: low-band attention injects high-band cues
Transformer → long/short position, trained on returns
FIR kernels θ are learned end
trained on return + Sharpe, not MSE
